text.p: These are the leading stories in the Beirut press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-French Foreign Minister De Charette due in Beirut on five-hour official visit to meet President Hrawi and other officials.
-Five suspected members of the Japanese Red Army will be charged today with passport forgery and three other Japanese will be released.
-Israeli warplanes raided suspected Hizbollah positions in south Lebanon.
-Police seized weapons in Mayfouq valley northeast Beirut.
-Prosecutor general demanded death sentence for former Christian warlord Geagea with assassination attempt on interior minister Murr in 1991.
-U.S. security delegation discussed cooperation against drug smuggling with Justice Minister Tabbara.
-General Confederation of Labour filed a complaint against government for interfering in its internal affairs.
